meta.description: OPTIONAL alternative publish path. The default Phase 1 build publishes from the Next.js interactivity route (src/app/api/webhooks/slack-interactivity), which is where Slack button clicks land. Import this only if you prefer to centralise the Ayrshare call in n8n; then point the route's publish step at this webhook instead. Replace {{ AYRSHARE_CREDENTIAL_ID }} with an n8n HTTP Header Auth credential storing 'Authorization: Bearer <AYRSHARE_API_KEY>'. For X/Twitter add the two X-Twitter-OAuth1-* headers.
